title: Let There Be Joy
lyrics: Let there be [A]joy, let there be [A]peace,
let there be [A]power, let there be [A]praise.
Let there be [G]joy, [D]joy in the Holy [A]Ghost.
It was for [A]freedom that we were set [A]free,
Let ev'ry [A]mountain, be cast to the [A]sea.
Let there be [G]joy, [D]joy in the Holy [A]Ghost
Ev'ry [G]eye shall see, ev'ry [D]ear shall hear,
Let there be [G]joy, [D]joy in the Holy [A]Ghost
Let there be joy, joy in the Holy Ghost
